name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.164: Reject counters now count every discarded candidate, and the run lines print them.
    A run that fetched 50 files and kept 41 reported "1 rejected". The counter covered four
    download gates and one upload gate, while the hearing-impaired block and 16 other upload
    paths stored a Rejected verdict and counted nothing — the GUI column showed a fraction.
    The counters now count everything fetched and thrown away, both run lines carry the number,
    and the fields were renamed to match their widened meaning. Nothing that was never fetched
    is counted. Schema marker 2 -> 3.
